explain.say: Here is a trick to try. Touch a metal spoon and a wooden spoon from the same drawer. The metal one feels colder! But here is the surprise: both are exactly the same temperature. Look at the board, and let's solve this mystery.

explain.say: Now sort them! Materials where heat moves fast are thermal conductors: metal pans and foil. Slow ones are insulators: wood, plastic, wool and cork. That is why pan handles are plastic! Brilliant thinking! Challenge: test a metal key and a plastic toy straight from the fridge.

faq.a: Metal is a good thermal conductor, so it carries heat away from your warm hand very quickly. Your skin senses heat leaving, and you feel cold, even though the metal is at room temperature.
asks: Why does metal feel colder than wood?

faq.a: A thermal conductor is a material that lets heat move through it easily, like metals: copper, aluminium, iron and steel.
A thermal insulator is a material that lets heat move through it only slowly, like wood, plastic, wool, cork and trapped air.

faq.q: Why do pan handles have plastic covers?
faq.a: The metal pan carries heat to the food quickly, but a plastic or wooden handle is an insulator, so heat does not reach your hand and you do not get burned.
asks: Why are cooking pots made of metal?

faq.q: Why do woolly jumpers keep you warm?
faq.a: Wool is an insulator and traps lots of air, which is a poor conductor. So the heat from your body stays close to you instead of escaping.

facts: Metals are good thermal conductors; wood, plastics and still air are poor conductors (insulators).
Objects left in the same room reach the same temperature, but conductors feel colder because they draw heat from skin faster.

quiz.say: A metal spoon and a wooden spoon have been in the same drawer all night. Which is colder?
quiz.why: Both are at room temperature; the metal only feels colder because it takes heat from your hand faster.

wrong.0: It feels colder, but its real temperature is the same as the wood.
wrong.1: The wooden spoon feels warmer, but both are really the same temperature.

quiz.say: Which material makes the best handle for a hot pan?
quiz.show: The best pan handle is made of…
quiz.why: Wood is a thermal insulator, so heat does not reach your hand.

wrong.0: Copper is a great conductor and would get very hot.
wrong.2: Foil is a metal and would get hot fast.
